old_caption: The video captures the majestic Niagara Falls from an aerial perspective, showcasing its powerful flow and vibrant turquoise water cascading over the edge. The camera begins by focusing on the falls, highlighting the intense white foam created by the rushing water as it crashes into the basin below. As the camera pans slightly downward, the mist from the falls becomes more prominent, creating a dramatic effect against the overcast sky. In the background, a bridge spans across the river, providing a sense of scale and context to the vastness of the waterfall. The surrounding landscape features lush greenery and trees, adding a natural frame to the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of awe-inspiring natural beauty and raw power.

caption: The video captures an elevated view of a broad waterfall where a churning river rushes toward the brink in bands of white foam. Emerald-green sheets of water plunge over the lip, their surface texture and the boundary with the froth shifting constantly. A few low rocky islets and a cluster of dark rocks protrude at the edge, while a long bridge spans the water against a tree-lined, overcast shoreline. Throughout the excerpt the rapids keep breaking and reforming along the crest, and the falling curtains maintain a steady cascade. A white mist plume rising from the unseen base grows larger and more prominent, gradually obscuring the lower part of the falling water. The framing drifts slightly, shifting the brink upward to reveal more of the plunge and the swelling spray.
